# Madhusudhan et al. 2025 MIRI spectra

Source: OSF https://osf.io/gmhw3/ (see the original `Readme.txt`), supplement to Madhusudhan et al., "New Constraints on DMS and DMDS in the Atmosphere of K2-18 b from JWST MIRI"
([arXiv:2504.12267](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.12267), ApJL, doi 10.3847/2041-8213/adc1c8). Reductions: JExoRES, JexoPipe. Columns: wavelength (um), bin half-width, depth (fraction), uncertainty.
Posterior images were not fetched. The 2023 NIRISS/NIRSpec paper (arXiv:2309.05566) has no public spectrum release that I could find.
